policy.eligible_current: fingerprinted current claims: terminal results plus unresolved positives counted as FN; unresolved negatives stay unresolved
policy.excluded_retry: stale provenance, nonterminal, or cases that must be rerun; excluded from every standard metric denominator
policy.metric_rule: accuracy, precision, recall and F1 keep their standard different denominators, but all draw from the same eligible_current claim sets

mainline.policy: Mainline claims are current only when a frozen sample case has a fingerprinted terminal stage-3 summary under the current protocol; stale runs never enter any metric.
